terra.problem: Saying David is not guarding his words because he is shy adds something the text does not say.
Saying David's eyes are free to roam adds a detail the text does not give.
“That's why he finally speaks” assigns a reason for David speaking that the text does not state.
“No friends in the room” adds a room and says who is absent from it, neither of which the text establishes.
Saying David's fathers felt like visitors assigns them a feeling the text does not state.
